description: This file contains the implementation of a broadcast channel writer in C# for the Orleans distributed application framework. It defines an interface for writing to a broadcast channel and a class that implements this interface, handling publication of items to subscribers, including logging and error handling.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelWriter<T>
classes.description: Implements a broadcast channel writer that publishes items to subscribers, with support for fire-and-forget delivery mode, logging, and error handling.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes an item to all implicit subscribers of the channel, either asynchronously with fire-and-forget or with awaiting all tasks.

methods.name: PublishToSubscriber
methods.description: Sends a published item to a single subscriber and handles exceptions during the send process.
